program:
app "Office tasks" bag plum
table work_task title text, done bool, tag pick Urgent|Normal|Waiting|Idea = Urgent, priority pick Low|Normal|High = Normal, due date?
count(work_task where done = no) "open" head
each work_task where done = no sort priority desc as t
  row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
    toggle t.done
    stack grow
      t.title bold
      t.tag t.due small color if(t.due < today, bad, muted)
form work_task
"Done" faint
list work_task where done = yes
button "Clear done" tap remove all work_task where done = yes
describe:
Office tasks, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- work task: title: text; done: yes or no; tag: one of Urgent, Normal, Waiting, Idea, starts at Urgent; priority: one of Low, Normal, High, starts at Normal; due: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: how many work task entries where done is no, "open".
- for each work task where done is no sorted by priority, highest first:
  - a group; a tap opens the work task for editing; a swipe removes the work task, with undo:
    - a tick box for the done of the work task.
    - text: the title of the work task.
    - text: the tag of the work task, the due of the work task.
- a form to add a work task.
- text: "Done".
- a list of work task where done is yes; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
- a button "Clear done"; a tap removes all work task entries where done is yes, with one undo.

fuller_style: chatty with a reason why the person needs it, 22 to 38 words

program:
app "Craft stock" gift plum
table craft_item name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 3, price money?, kind pick Big|Small|Spare, expires date?
state q text = ""
let short = count(craft_item, it.qty <= it.low)
short "items running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each craft_item where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(craft_item, it.qty * it.price) faint
form craft_item
remind "Check your items" at 9:00 on sat
describe:
Craft stock, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- craft item: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 3; price: money, optional; kind: one of Big, Small, Spare; expires: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the craft item have its qty is at most its low.
Remembers while you use it: q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: short, "items running low".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search".
- for each craft item where name contains q sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the craft item for editing; a swipe removes the craft item, with undo:
    - text: the name of the craft item.
    - text: the kind of the craft item.
    - text: "Expires", the expires of the craft item.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the craft item to the qty of the craft item minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the craft item.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the craft item to the qty of the craft item plus 1.
- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the craft item.
- a form to add a craft item.
Reminder "Check your items" at 9:00 on Sat.
